traits.name: Leader’s Resolve
traits.desc: Allies within 30 ft. gain +1 to attack rolls and saving throws while Arlon is conscious.

traits.name: Rebel Inspiration (Recharge 5–6)
traits.desc: One ally within 30 ft. gains an inspiration die (d8) they can add to an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw.

traits.name: Indomitable Will (1/Day)
traits.desc: When Arlon fails a saving throw, he can reroll and must use the second result.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.desc: _Melee Weapon Attack_: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. _Hit_: 11 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage, or 12 (1d10 + 3) if used with two hands.

actions.name: Commanding Shout (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: Arlon shouts orders—each ally within 30 ft. who can hear him can make one weapon attack as a reaction.

bonus_actions.name: Tactical Positioning
bonus_actions.desc: Arlon moves up to half his speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary_actions.name: Tactical Strike (1/Day Optional)
legendary_actions.desc: After another creature ends its turn, Arlon can move up to half his speed and make one weapon attack.

nested.callback: return `Kill one _${monster.name}_ for every ${monster.hp} damage dealt to the mob`
